newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT single brand to help German mkt share.
newsitem.headline: TNT single brand to help German mkt share.

text.p: Courier company TNT said integration of its German subsidiaries into a single company this year would give clients clearer and better services.
Vinzenz Wagner, chairman of TNT Holding GmbH, said he expected a simpler sales structure and in-house synergy effects from the integration of TNT subsidiaries into a national organisation.

National express unit TNT Express, international operator TNT Worldwide Express and overnight distributor NET would be marketed in Germany under the single brand name TNT by the end of 1997, he told Reuters in an interview.
The integration is part of the overall re-structuring by new owner, Dutch post group KPN, of TNT Ltd, GD Express Worldwide and parts of PTT Post into TNT, he noted.

Wagner, now in charge of all three German subsidiaries, said: "Clients will no longer have to deal with one salesman for national express and a different one for international business. We will have one face to the customer."
The two parallel computer systems would be merged and new products would be offered as soon as possible, he added.
Wagner said there would be no substantial jobs losses since growth had normally forced the company to employ more staff in recent years.
"We are on target on turnover and profits for the three companies," he added.
The TNT companies had combined turnover of 750 million marks and 10 million consignments in Germany in 1996. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017 - www.racs.com
